feature: api/img.js — image proxy for Vercel Blob (private + public)

test_cases.title: API endpoint /api/img returns an image response, not JSON and not a redirect to an inaccessible URL
preconditions: Fix is deployed to the target environment (staging or production)
BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN is set in Vercel environment variables
At least one image exists on Blob: images/dang_tin/home.jpg
steps: Open browser DevTools > Network tab
Navigate to https://npvn-training-site.vercel.app/training-engine.html?module=dang_tin
Wait for step 1 to render
In the Network tab, find the request matching /api/img?path=images/dang_tin/home.jpg
Inspect the final response (follow all redirects to the last response)
test_cases.expected: The final response has HTTP status 200. The Content-Type header is 'image/jpeg' (or 'image/png'/'image/webp' if applicable). The response body is binary image bytes — no JSON payload visible. The element in the phone mockup displays the screenshot (not a broken image icon).
test_cases.notes: Root cause: current code does 302 to private blob URL which browser cannot access without Bearer token. After fix, private blobs must be proxied server-side.

test_cases.title: Image renders visually inside training-engine.html phone mockup for step 1 of dang_tin
preconditions: Fix is deployed
BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN is set
images/dang_tin/home.jpg is on Blob
steps: Open Chrome, navigate to https://npvn-training-site.vercel.app/training-engine.html?module=dang_tin
Wait up to 5 seconds for the phone mockup to load
Observe the phone screen area inside the mockup frame
test_cases.expected: The phone screen shows a real screenshot of the Nha Pho app home screen. No broken-image icon (torn page symbol) is visible. The hotspot overlay (green pulsing rectangle) is positioned on top of the visible screenshot.
test_cases.notes: Visual pass criterion: screenshot is recognisable, not a grey/white blank or broken-image icon. Hotspot overlay position correctness is out of scope for this test case.

test_cases.title: Public blob: /api/img issues 302 redirect to public CDN URL that browser can access without auth
preconditions: Fix is deployed
BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN is set
An image has been uploaded with access: 'public' (new upload path via api/upload.js). Confirm by checking blob pathname on public subdomain.
steps: Using curl with redirect following disabled: curl -I 'https://npvn-training-site.vercel.app/api/img?path=<public_blob_path>'
Note the HTTP status code and Location header value
Separately, perform a GET to the Location URL without any Authorization header
test_cases.expected: Step 1 response: HTTP 302, Location header points to a URL on *.public.blob.vercel-storage.com (public CDN) with no auth token in URL. Step 2 response: HTTP 200 from the CDN URL with Content-Type image/*. This confirms public blobs do not require auth and the redirect is safe to follow.
test_cases.notes: If no public blob exists yet, upload one via admin panel first using api/upload.js (which sets access: 'public'). Public blob path format: images/<module>/<key>.jpg on public subdomain.

test_cases.title: Private blob: /api/img proxies image bytes server-side with Bearer auth — does NOT redirect to private URL
preconditions: Fix is deployed
BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN is set
A known legacy private blob exists (e.g., images/dang_tin/home.jpg uploaded before public access change). Confirm it is on private subdomain by checking that HEAD on public subdomain returns 404.
steps: Run: curl -v 'https://npvn-training-site.vercel.app/api/img?path=images/dang_tin/home.jpg' -o /dev/null
Observe all HTTP transactions in verbose output
Check final HTTP status, Content-Type header, Cache-Control header
Confirm no redirect step goes to a *.private.blob.vercel-storage.com URL
test_cases.expected: Single HTTP 200 response from npvn-training-site.vercel.app (no redirect to private blob domain). Content-Type: image/jpeg. Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400. Response body is non-zero binary data (image bytes). No 302 to private subdomain at any step in the redirect chain.
test_cases.notes: This is the primary regression test for the root cause fix. If the response is a 302 to *.private.blob.vercel-storage.com, the fix has NOT been applied or is not working.

test_cases.title: Path traversal attempt returns HTTP 400
preconditions: Fix is deployed
BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN is set (or not — this check runs before token lookup)
steps: Send: GET /api/img?path=../../etc/passwd
Send: GET /api/img?path=../images/dang_tin/home.jpg
Send: GET /api/img?path=/images/dang_tin/home.jpg  (starts with /)
Send: GET /api/img?path=images%2F..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd  (URL-encoded ..)
test_cases.expected: All four requests return HTTP 400 with JSON body { "error": "invalid_path" }. No image bytes are returned. No 500 error. The URL-encoded variant (step 4) should also be rejected — verify that the validation handles both raw and decoded forms.
test_cases.notes: Current code checks path.includes('..') and path.startsWith('/'). Step 4 tests whether URL-decoded input is also validated — express/Node typically decodes query params before the handler sees them, so encoded '..' should also be caught. If step 4 returns 200 or 404 rather than 400, flag as HIGH severity finding.

test_cases.title: Path not found on Blob returns HTTP 404 with JSON error body
preconditions: Fix is deployed
BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN is set
The path images/dang_tin/does_not_exist_xyz.jpg does NOT exist on Blob (verify this)
steps: Send: GET /api/img?path=images/dang_tin/does_not_exist_xyz.jpg
Inspect HTTP status code
Inspect response body
test_cases.expected: HTTP 404. Response body is JSON: { "error": "not_found", "path": "images/dang_tin/does_not_exist_xyz.jpg", "message": "..." }. Content-Type of the error response is application/json. No HTML error page. No 500.
test_cases.notes: Friendly 404 JSON is required so the front-end (or a future admin panel) can surface a useful error message instead of a generic network error.

test_cases.title: Cache-Control header is 'public, max-age=86400' on a successful image response
preconditions: Fix is deployed
A valid image path exists on Blob (e.g., images/dang_tin/home.jpg)
steps: Send: curl -I 'https://npvn-training-site.vercel.app/api/img?path=images/dang_tin/home.jpg'
For a private blob (proxied response): inspect Cache-Control header in the 200 response
For a public blob (302 redirect): inspect Cache-Control header on the /api/img 302 response
test_cases.expected: Private blob (proxied): Cache-Control header value is exactly 'public, max-age=86400'. Public blob (redirect): Cache-Control on the 302 may be 'public, max-age=3600' (current code) — note the value; the spec requirement from the bug context is max-age=86400. Flag discrepancy between public and private if values differ significantly.
test_cases.notes: The proposed fix code sets Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400. The current code for public (redirect) sets max-age=3600. If Tech Lead confirms both should be 86400, update expectation accordingly. As written, the test verifies the private proxy path matches the proposed fix spec.

test_cases.title: Content-Type header is image/jpeg (or image/*) on a successful response — NOT application/json
preconditions: Fix is deployed
Valid JPEG image exists on Blob: images/dang_tin/home.jpg
Valid JPEG image exists on Blob: images/loc_kho/home.jpg
steps: Send: curl -I 'https://npvn-training-site.vercel.app/api/img?path=images/dang_tin/home.jpg'
Check Content-Type header on the final 200 response
Repeat for images/loc_kho/home.jpg
Repeat for images/bo_suu_tap/b01_list.jpg
test_cases.expected: All three requests return a final 200 response where Content-Type is 'image/jpeg'. Value must NOT be 'application/json', 'text/html', or 'application/octet-stream'. The header must be present — absence of Content-Type is also a failure.
test_cases.notes: The proposed fix derives Content-Type from the upstream fetch response header. If upstream does not return Content-Type, the fix defaults to 'image/jpeg'. Both paths are acceptable. If a PNG is stored instead of JPEG, expect 'image/png'.

test_cases.title: When BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN is not set, /api/img returns HTTP 500 immediately — no hang
preconditions: A local or staging environment where BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN is intentionally unset or removed
The fix code is deployed to this environment
steps: Ensure BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN is not set in the environment (remove from .env or Vercel env vars for the test environment)
Send: GET /api/img?path=images/dang_tin/home.jpg
Measure time to first byte — should be under 2 seconds
Inspect HTTP status and response body
test_cases.expected: HTTP 500 within 2 seconds. Response body is JSON: { "error": "not_configured", "message": "BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN chưa set" }. The function does NOT hang or time out at 30s. No unhandled exception in Vercel function logs.
test_cases.notes: This test cannot be run against production without removing the token. Use a separate staging deployment or Vercel preview with the env var deleted. The current code already has this guard — the test verifies it is preserved after the fix is applied.

test_cases.title: ALL live content modules display images without any broken image — run in incognito browser
preconditions: Fix is deployed
BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN is set
Use Chrome Incognito (Ctrl+Shift+N) — NOT the browser that was used in admin. Incognito has no IndexedDB cache, which is the only environment that exposes missing Blob uploads.
All images for modules below must have proxyUrl (/api/img?path=...) in modules.json — verify by checking production modules.json before running
steps: Mở Chrome Incognito (Ctrl+Shift+N) — KHÔNG dùng browser đã mở admin
Mở DevTools → Network tab → filter 'Img'
Với MỖI module trong danh sách moduleList: navigate đến /training-engine.html?module=[id]
Click qua từng step. Ghi lại bất kỳ step nào ảnh bị trắng/broken
Sau khi xong mỗi module, kiểm tra Network tab: có request /api/img nào trả 404/502 không
Điền kết quả vào cột actual: PASS / FAIL [step N: mô tả lỗi]
test_cases.expected: Zero broken images across ALL steps of ALL modules. Every /api/img request shows HTTP 200. No 401, 403, 404, or 502 for image paths that have been uploaded.
test_cases.notes: THAY ĐỔI SO VỚI PHIÊN BẢN CŨ: (1) Mở rộng từ 3 module gốc sang TẤT CẢ module có images. (2) Bắt buộc dùng incognito — browser có IndexedDB từ admin sẽ che giấu bug ảnh thiếu Blob. (3) Cập nhật moduleList mỗi khi thêm module mới. Nếu module nào chưa có ảnh Blob (content gap), ghi chú riêng và KHÔNG tính là lỗi proxy — nhưng phải báo cho PM biết trước release.
test_cases.updatePolicy: Mỗi khi thêm module mới vào modules.json, thêm vào moduleList và chạy lại TC-10 trước khi release. Xem UPL-007 trong admin_image_upload.json để biết checklist đầy đủ.
